query: Which human–AI interaction metrics (override/acceptance rate, automation bias, time-to-decision, clinician trust, patient comprehension) are primary endpoints and how should they be measured in pilot studies?

response.query: Which human–AI interaction metrics (override/acceptance rate, automation bias, time-to-decision, clinician trust, patient comprehension) are primary endpoints and how should they be measured in pilot studies?
response.answer: Primary endpoints in human–AI interaction studies include override/acceptance rate, automation bias, time-to-decision, clinician trust, and patient comprehension, measured via surveys, decision logs, and time tracking.
